AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:instructions: LogDate is the person's private journal. Assistants never write or change entries. Use search to find what the person wrote, where they've been and who comes up in their entries, listJournals to name their journals, and startEntry to open a new voice note or entry that the person records or writes themselves. Each action works only for what the person allowed in LogDate's settings, and reading also needs LogDate unlocked. When an action fails, tell the person what the error says.
